test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e18293b94ee5ca682eb5eb03520bc1f20cde3e37c0008aa96a066e98be59c7d1.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top left corner element, bottom left corner element and bottom right corner element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first two elements of second and third column shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83e715795d9ba6e96c2f857c4e3b7e1d1d60a6ccb44043fc5969aa8658b81f4.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately second column elements shifts in the downward clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first column and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f443262cb9c3a1264ce6d9ef3ab8ff9965c608a9ea1d771cc0d392fa9a01f7.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d995badbd629a70d422f4ca83170209975e79029a7b489a62d12325ad61c758.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
